commands.mnocmdextra.tp2p.spawnpoint: %s has been teleported back to his/her spawnpoint.

commands.mnocmdextra.tp2p.help:
Usage:
"/tp2p <player>": Teleport yourself to the given player.
"/tp2p back": Teleport back to the position where you ran "/tp2p <player>" or "/tp2p spawnpoint" last time.
"/tp2p memorize": Memorize the current position.
"/tp2p spawnpoint": Teleport yourself to your spawnpoint.
